---
title: "Guns vs. Butter"
subtitle: "NATO defense commitments and foreign aid, 2014–2025"
date: "2025-06-12"
categories: [Data Story, Global Development, Aid, NATO, Defense, ODA]
---

<span class="kicker">Data Story &nbsp;·&nbsp; NATO &amp; OECD DAC &nbsp;·&nbsp; Defense and Aid Spending 2014&#8211;2025</span>

::: {.lead}
Every government faces a version of the same tradeoff: how much to spend on security
at home versus stability abroad. NATO asks members to spend 2% of GDP on defense.
The OECD asks donors to give 0.7% of GNI in foreign aid. Almost no country
has ever met both targets simultaneously — and the gap is growing.
:::

```{=html}
var barChart = null;

function getIdx(year) { return YEARS.indexOf(year); }

function getCountries() {
  return showUSA ? COUNTRIES : COUNTRIES.filter(function(c){return c!=='USA';});
}

// ── BAR CHART ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function getBarData(year) {
  var yi = getIdx(year);
  var countries = getCountries();

  // Sort countries
  countries = countries.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
    var aVal = sortByDefense ? NATO_BN[a][yi] : ODA_BN[a][yi];
    var bVal = sortByDefense ? NATO_BN[b][yi] : ODA_BN[b][yi];
    return aVal - bVal; // ascending for horizontal bar (largest at top)
  });

  return {
    labels: countries,
    defense: countries.map(function(c){ return NATO_BN[c][yi]; }),
    oda: countries.map(function(c){ return ODA_BN[c][yi]; })
  };
}

function initBarChart(year) {
  var d = getBarData(year);
  var ctx = document.getElementById('gvb-bar').getContext('2d');
  var h = Math.max(400, d.labels.length * 28);
  document.getElementById('gvb-bar').height = h;

  barChart = new Chart(ctx, {
    type: 'bar',
    data: {
      labels: d.labels,
      datasets: [
        {
          label: 'Defense (NATO)',
          data: d.defense,
          backgroundColor: '#f87171cc',
          borderColor: '#f87171',
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderRadius: 3
        },
        {
          label: 'ODA',
          data: d.oda,
          backgroundColor: '#60a5facc',
          borderColor: '#60a5fa',
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderRadius: 3
        }
      ]
    },
    options: {
      indexAxis: 'y',
      responsive: true,
      interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
      plugins: {
        legend: {
          position: 'top',
          labels: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 12 }, padding: 16, boxWidth: 16 }
        },
        tooltip: {
          backgroundColor: '#060c1a', borderColor: '#1e2d45', borderWidth: 1,
          titleColor: '#94a3b8', bodyColor: '#e2e8f0', padding: 10,
          callbacks: {
            label: function(c) {
              return ' ' + c.dataset.label + ': $' + c.parsed.x.toFixed(1) + 'B';
            }
          }
        }
      },
      scales: {
        x: {
          grid: { color: '#111d30' },
          ticks: { color: '#4a6080', font: { size: 11 },
            callback: function(v){ return '$'+v+'B'; }
          },
          title: { display: true, text: 'USD billions', color: '#4a6080', font: { size: 11 } }
        },
        y: {
          grid: { color: '#111d30' },
          ticks: { color: '#94a3b8', font: { size: 11 } }
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

function updateBarChart(year) {
  var d = getBarData(year);
  var h = Math.max(400, d.labels.length * 28);
  document.getElementById('gvb-bar').height = h;
  barChart.data.labels = d.labels;
  barChart.data.datasets[0].data = d.defense;
  barChart.data.datasets[1].data = d.oda;
  barChart.update();
}

function getScatterData(year) {
  var yi = getIdx(year);
  return COUNTRIES.map(function(c, i) {
    var odaPct = (ODA_BN[c][yi] / GDP_BN[c][yi]) * 100;
    return {
      x: NATO_PCT[c][yi],
      y: parseFloat(odaPct.toFixed(3)),
      label: c,
      color: SCATTER_COLORS[i]
    };
  });
}

function initScatterChart(year) {
  var pts = getScatterData(year);
  var ctx = document.getElementById('gvb-scatter').getContext('2d');

  var datasets = pts.map(function(p) {
    return {
      label: p.label,
      data: [{ x: p.x, y: p.y }],
      backgroundColor: p.color + 'cc',
      borderColor: p.color,
      pointRadius: 7,
      pointHoverRadius: 9,
      borderWidth: 1.5
    };
  });

  // Reference line datasets
  datasets.push({
    label: '2% NATO target',
    data: [{ x:2, y:-0.1 }, { x:2, y:1.4 }],
    type: 'line',
    borderColor: '#f87171',
    borderWidth: 1.5,
    borderDash: [6,4],
    pointRadius: 0,
    fill: false,
    tension: 0
  });
  datasets.push({
    label: '0.7% ODA target',
    data: [{ x:0, y:0.7 }, { x:5.5, y:0.7 }],
    type: 'line',
    borderColor: '#60a5fa',
    borderWidth: 1.5,
    borderDash: [6,4],
    pointRadius: 0,
    fill: false,
    tension: 0
  });

  scatterChart = new Chart(ctx, {
    type: 'scatter',
    data: { datasets: datasets },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      plugins: {
        legend: { display: false },
        tooltip: {
          backgroundColor: '#060c1a', borderColor: '#1e2d45', borderWidth: 1,
          titleColor: '#64748b', bodyColor: '#e2e8f0', padding: 10,
          callbacks: {
            title: function(items) {
              var ds = scatterChart.data.datasets[items[0].datasetIndex];
              return ds.label;
            },
            label: function(item) {
              return [
                ' Defense: ' + item.parsed.x.toFixed(1) + '% of GDP',
                ' ODA: ' + item.parsed.y.toFixed(2) + '% of GNI'
              ];
            }
          }
        }
      },
      scales: {
        x: {
          grid: { color: '#111d30' },
          ticks: { color: '#4a6080', font: { size: 11 },
            callback: function(v){ return v+'%'; }
          },
          title: { display: true, text: 'Defense spending % of GDP', color:'#4a6080', font:{size:11} },
          min: 0, max: 5.5
        },
        y: {
          grid: { color: '#111d30' },
          ticks: { color: '#4a6080', font: { size: 11 },
            callback: function(v){ return v+'%'; }
          },
          title: { display: true, text: 'ODA % of GNI', color:'#4a6080', font:{size:11} },
          min: 0, max: 1.4
        }
      }
    },
    plugins: [{
      id: 'countryLabels',
      afterDatasetsDraw: function(chart) {
        var ctx2 = chart.ctx;
        ctx2.save();
        ctx2.font = "10px 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif";
        ctx2.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
        ctx2.textAlign = 'left';
        chart.data.datasets.forEach(function(ds, i) {
          if (!ds.data || ds.data.length !== 1) return;
          var meta = chart.getDatasetMeta(i);
          if (meta.data && meta.data[0]) {
            var pt = meta.data[0];
            ctx2.fillText(ds.label, pt.x + 6, pt.y + 4);
          }
        });
        ctx2.restore();
      }
    }]
  });
}

function updateScatterChart(year) {
  var pts = getScatterData(year);
  pts.forEach(function(p, i) {
    scatterChart.data.datasets[i].data = [{ x: p.x, y: p.y }];
  });
  scatterChart.update();
}

// ── CONTROLS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
window.gvbToggleUSA = function(btn) {
  showUSA = !showUSA;
  btn.classList.toggle('active', showUSA);
  updateBarChart(currentYear);
};

window.gvbToggleSort = function(btn) {
  sortByDefense = !sortByDefense;
  btn.textContent = 'Sort by: ' + (sortByDefense ? 'Defense' : 'ODA');
  updateBarChart(currentYear);
};

document.getElementById('gvb-slider').addEventListener('input', function() {
  currentYear = parseInt(this.value);
  document.getElementById('gvb-yr').textContent = currentYear;
  document.getElementById('gvb-prelim').style.display = currentYear >= 2024 ? 'inline' : 'none';
  updateBarChart(currentYear);
  updateScatterChart(currentYear);
});

var _rt;
window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
  clearTimeout(_rt);
  _rt = setTimeout(function() {
    updateBarChart(currentYear);
    updateScatterChart(currentYear);
  }, 200);
});

// ── INIT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    initBarChart(currentYear);
    initScatterChart(currentYear);
  });
} else {
  initBarChart(currentYear);
  initScatterChart(currentYear);
}

})();
</script>
```

---

**Sources:** NATO Defence Expenditure of NATO Countries (2014–2025), published August 2025
(estimates for 2024–2025). OECD DAC Statistics, final 2024 release December 2025,
preliminary 2025 release April 2026. GDP estimates: IMF World Economic Outlook.
ODA/GNI ratios are approximated using GDP as proxy for GNI.
Countries shown are NATO members that are also OECD DAC donors.
Finland joined NATO April 2023; Sweden joined March 2024.
